newsitem.title: UK: EMAP says not involved in Blenheim raid.
newsitem.headline: EMAP says not involved in Blenheim raid.

text.p: UK publishing group EMAP Plc on Tuesday denied being involved in a stock market raid on Blenheim Group Plc, after EMAP's broker NatWest bought a 14.9 percent stake in the exhibitions organiser.
A spokesman for EMAP said: "It was all news to us."
EMAP shares were up 1/2p at 776 by 0955 GMT while Blenheim was up 36p at 471-1/2, well below the day's best of 500p after NatWest bid 500p in the market for the stake.
Market sources said the raid was launched on behalf of an unnamed large European media company but was not a prelude to a full bid.
However EMAP had initially been seen as one possible company behind the raid because NatWest is its broker.
